details:
Q1
Which part of this repository should change? (If you know the exact workflow or file path, include it in your answer.)
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows or their scripts/prompts
B. Review/autofix, conflict resolution, orchestrator, or validation workflows/scripts
C. Documentation / README / operator/runbook content
D. Another specific file or path. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior or regression — include current vs expected behavior and how to reproduce it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change workflow behavior — describe the exact new behavior and any constraints.
C. Improve reliability, observability, or performance — describe the current pain point and what “better” should look like.
D. Update docs/text — quote the section/text to change and describe the desired wording or structure.
Q3
What should count as done for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow/job/script outcome should change — describe the expected result. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific GitHub-side symptom should stop/change — name the label, comment, PR status, alert, or run outcome.
C. A specific file/section should end up with new content — identify the file/section and the desired end state.
